blocks.text: A home they can finally and proudly call their own. After years of loss and a long legal fight, the family of the late Baby Jane Teodoro Allas received just that on Oct. 2, when Vista Land & Lifescapes Inc., the country’s biggest homebuilder, turned over a Camella house and lot in Puerto Princesa to her children. For the family, this new home brings a sense of stability Baby Jane had worked so hard to give her children. It is also a fitting gesture from a homegrown company whose own story has long been tied to the Filipino dream of homeownership. […]...
